entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 542 aa protein with N-terminal CTP_synth_N domain (PF06418.21; residues 3–264) and C-terminal glutaminase GATase domain (PF00117.35; residues 301–533).
Shows 80.6–82.1% full-length identity and 100% coverage to reviewed bacterial CTP synthases A6X0L6, Q11HU6, and C0RJA5.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source; exact substrate usage is inferred from homologs and domains.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 60.1 kDa; predicted acidic pI approximately 5.37.

entities.name: A6X0L6 CTP synthase
observations: Reviewed Brucella anthropi CTP synthase; EC 6.3.4.2.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using L-glutamine or ammonia.
Annotated to de novo CTP biosynthesis and pyrimidine nucleobase biosynthesis.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: CTP synthase performs the final step of de novo CTP production from UTP, ATP, and nitrogen donor.

entities.name: UTP to CTP amination
observations: Overall reaction candidate: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate; ammonia can substitute for glutamine-derived nitrogen.
Associated EC number: 6.3.4.2; Rhea mapping includes RHEA:26426 and ammonia-dependent RHEA:16597.
